verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing page directly claims to 'automate GL coding by entity globally' and highlights AI-powered automation of invoice entry/approval, which aligns with the story, but this is a single high-level marketing line with no developer docs, API details, or independent corroboration on how GL-code assignment works across entities. Community evidence about AI reliability concerns relates to a different chatbot feature, not GL coding specifically, so it doesn't dispute this claim but also doesn't support it. missing for 10: technical documentation on GL-code automation logic, multi-entity handling specifics, and independent/hands-on verification of accuracy.
